sections.title: Internal panel brief
sections.note: Confidential. Internal working record. No result is published by this system.
sections.sql: select entry,judge,declaration,due_on,criteria_required,criteria_scored,weighted_score from awards.judging_progress where season_id=$1 order by entry,judge

sections.title: Internal decision record
sections.note: Confidential. Internal working record. No result is published by this system.
sections.sql: select name,entrant,decision,decision_reason from awards.entries where season_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Judging score ledger
sections.note: Confidential. Internal working record. No result is published by this system.
sections.sql: select p.entry,p.judge,p.declaration,c.name as criterion,c.weight,s.value,s.rationale from awards.scores s join awards.criteria c on c.id=s.criterion_id join awards.judging_progress p on p.id=s.assignment_id where p.season_id=$1 order by p.entry,p.judge,c.name
